description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASESeptember 25, 2024Contact: press@leawebb.comSouthern Tier, NY - Today, Senator Lea Webb (D, NY-52) announced that she has been endorsed by the New York State Federation of Democratic Women. NYSFDW is the latest organization dedicated to women’s equality to come out in support of Senator Webb’s reelection campaign. She has been endorsed by Eleanor’s Legacy, Planned Parenthood, and Family Planning Action Fund of South Central New York.Said Denise Murphy McGraw, President, NYS

title: New York State Federation of Democratic Women Endorses Senator Lea Webb for Reelection to NY State Senate
